newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says rice stocks at 2.5 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says rice stocks at 2.5 mln tonnes.

text.p: Indonesia's rice stocks totalled 2.5 million tonnes at the end of October, down from 2.8 million tonnes in June, head of the state logistics bureau (BULOG) Beddu Amang said on Wednesday.
"Rice stocks were around 2.5 million tonnes in end October. We have enough rice for the next Moslem (Ramadan) fasting month," he told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
Amang said domestic rice procurement betweeen January and October this year totalled 1.38 million tonnes.
He said unhusked rice production was projected to rise to 50 million tonnes this year from 49 million tonnes in 1995.
He said sugar procurement in the January-October period was 1.83 million tonnes. Sugar stocks were at 832,240 tonnes.
He said based on data from the Indonesian sugar council sugar production was projected at 2.41 million tonnes in 1996, compared with 2.4 million tonnes in 1995.
